name: After § 121
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 121g. Calls on the Commission to introduce a tax on kerosene as a new own resource and to use it to plan and manage the winding down of the air transport sector, to support the sector’s employees and to develop alternative means of transport;
